newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil's 1997 Q1 GDP seen up 4.3 pct vs 1996 Q1.
newsitem.headline: Brazil's 1997 Q1 GDP seen up 4.3 pct vs 1996 Q1.

text.p: Brazil's gross domestic product in the first quarter of 1997 is expected to grow 4.3 percent when compared with the 1996 first quarter, the Planning Ministry's Applied Economic Research (Ipea) said.

Ipea said in its December report that the agricultural sector is likely to grow 8.1 percent in the first quarter, followed by the industrial sector at 4.7 percent and the services sector at 2.3 percent.
For the full year 1996, Ipea reiterated its projections of 3.0 percent GDP growth.
Regarding inflation, Ipea said it expects monthly inflation rates between 0.4 percent and 0.5 percent on average, which would result in annual inflation of 5.0 to 8.0 percent in 1997.
